issues.description: Users report that the app rejects their password, blocking them from signing in to their account.
issues.name: Password not accepted during login

issues.description: Customers report being unable to log into their account and find the app has too many advertisements.
issues.name: Account access blocked and excessive ads

issues.description: A single reviewer, writing in romanized Hindi with abusive language, objects to Spotify appearing to ask users for money, which they describe as begging; the review is the only example available, so the cluster is thin.
issues.name: Users angered by perceived donation requests in Spotify

issues.description: Recent update restricted skipping, replaying, song choice and queue features to free users unless they buy Premium, which customers see as forced paywalling.
issues.name: Free users locked out of core playback controls

issues.description: Customers report that many songs and genres, such as gospel music, are missing from the app's catalog.
issues.name: Missing songs and limited music selection

issues.description: Users report that lyrics do not appear for certain songs while appearing for others, making the feature inconsistent.
issues.name: Lyrics missing for some songs

issues.description: Users report that recommended tracks are inserted into their own playlists or that recommendations have shifted in quality, leaving them frustrated with the music suggestions they receive.
issues.name: Unwanted recommendations cluttering personal playlists

issues.description: Customers report that song downloads get stuck in the background and only resume after they manually open the app.
issues.name: Background downloads stall until app reopened

issues.description: Customers report that offline mode or downloaded content does not function as expected.
issues.name: Offline listening downloads not working

issues.description: Many reviewers express general disappointment, calling the app bad or worse and blaming a recent update without specifying any concrete feature or bug.
issues.name: Vague dissatisfaction with recent app updates

issues.description: Premium users report the app cannot connect to the internet over Wi-Fi while mobile data works, and some songs play at poor audio quality.
issues.name: Playback fails over Wi-Fi but works on mobile data

issues.description: Customers report the app crashes or freezes during playback and cannot be opened after the latest update.
issues.name: App crashes on launch after update

issues.description: Customers report that playback does not start, whether through voice assistant requests that announce a playlist without playing it, the app freezing on the loading screen, or songs being shuffled instead of played as chosen.
issues.name: Music fails to play or loads endlessly

issues.description: Music playback halts partway through a song and does not resume where it stopped, instead starting a different track.
issues.name: Playback stops unexpectedly mid-track

issues.description: Users find the app overloaded with ads, some of them loud, making it hard or frustrating to use without paying for premium.
issues.name: Excessive advertising disrupts app usability

issues.description: Customers report that ads interrupt or replace music playback and that various features, such as music adjustment and new UX changes, are buggy or hard to control.
issues.name: Ads and usability problems across the app

issues.description: Customers are frustrated that playlists play songs randomly or force them through entire playlists, with limited skipping, when they only want to hear a specific song.
issues.name: Playlist shuffle and queue control frustrations

issues.description: Users report that a recent update removed or hid basic player controls such as repeat, rewind, and section looping, and replaced the homescreen with a hard-to-use scrolling layout.
issues.name: Player and homescreen changes frustrate users
